comment: The between-match hook on a rotating free-for-all: a joined human who stands still, three rule bots and a short frag limit, so the bots become the human's nemesis. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP_ROTATE=1, FRAGR_QA_MODE=ffa, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=3, FRAGR_QA_FRAG_LIMIT=3 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/podium-vote.json.
